english.title: Attempt to make an unauthorised sale / purchase of a tram ticket for the Croydon Tramlink system
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[being an unauthorised person attempted to sell a Croydon Tramlink ticket, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TICKET..)]_
(B)_[attempted to buy a Croydon Tramlink ticket, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TICKET..), from an unauthorised person, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON AND THE CIRCUMSTANCES..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 22(1)(a), 30 and 26 of the Croydon Tramlink Byelaws made under section 46 of the Croydon Tramlink Act 1994.
english.pointstoprove:
date and place
being an unauthorised person
attempted to sell a Croydon Tramlink ticket OR
attempted to buy a Croydon Tramlink ticket from an unauthorised person
